comments: Confluence Cloud app on the Atlassian Marketplace. Free for sites of up to 10 users; 30-day trial for larger sites. Same engine as our free online checker, submitted separately.
features: Confluence Cloud app that checks pages as they are written and whole spaces: 32 checks across 15 WCAG 2.2 success criteria (alt text, contrast, headings, tables, links, language). Page scores, the pages to fix first, and a dated conformance report published in Confluence. Items that need human judgement are marked for review.
title: WCAG & ADA Accessibility Checker for Confluence
